coverage_note: No verifiable new items from University of Tokyo / RIKEN AIP's own site could be confirmed for the 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-13 window. This run was blocked from direct primary-source verification: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for aip.riken.jp, www.riken.jp, and all checked University of Tokyo subdomains (www.u-tokyo.ac.jp, www.ai.u-tokyo.ac.jp, www.i.u-tokyo.ac.jp, weblab.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp), as well as fallback mirrors (Google Translate proxy, Google cache, r.jina.ai, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Ecosia, Marginalia, nitter.net, x.com). Two possibly-relevant items (a BEA 2026 best-paper award for RIKEN AIP's Explainable AI Team, and a July 24, 2026 joint workshop with National Taiwan University's AI-CoRE) appeared only in synthesized search-summary text without a directly citable title+URL pair, so they were excluded to avoid citing an unverified source/date. Recommend retrying this collector once network egress to aip.riken.jp and u-tokyo.ac.jp is restored.
